source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: While this model leads a unit, that unit's models have Feel No Pain 6+. Once that unit destroys at least one enemy unit in the Fight phase, its models have Feel No Pain 5+ instead until the battle is over.
